action.sql: SELECT store_id, CASE WHEN order_date<'2024-02-01' THEN 'a_jan' WHEN order_date<'2024-03-15' THEN 'b_febmar' ELSE 'c_late' END per, count(*) n, avg(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) late_rate, avg(delay_days) d FROM purchase_order WHERE supplier_id='SUP-001' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
